answer: Resist sybils with threshold-share attestation: each identity authority is split into shares held by independent peers, and acting requires gathering a quorum, an anchor raised only when several crews pull together. One share is a pigment fleck, worthless alone; only the full spiral of gathered shares unlocks weight. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must win a quorum for each one from real peers who vet before sharing, while an honest agent collects its quorum once.
